Title: Nikhil's Day

Cast

1. Nikhil - 9 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Sonali - 35 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun

Places

1. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The bedroom - Day

[Nikhil stands in the bedroom. Sonali stands near him.]

Sonali: "Today feels like a good day."

[Nikhil yawns loudly.]

Sonali: "That's easy."

[Nikhil stretches his arms above his head.]

Sonali: "Show me too!"

[Nikhil goes to bed and falls asleep.]

Nikhil (happily): "Yes, of course."

[Nikhil sits on the edge of the bed.]

Nikhil (gently): "Careful!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Nikhil stands in the living room. Sonali stands near him.]

Nikhil: "Mom, look over here."

[Nikhil lies down on the sofa.]

Nikhil: "One more time!"

[Nikhil sits down on a chair.]

Nikhil (softly): "Exactly right."

[Nikhil flops down on the sofa.]

Nikhil (surprised): "How beautiful!"

[Nikhil sits cross-legged on the floor.]

Nikhil: "Mom, listen!"

Scene 3: The park - Day

Sonali: "What a nice place."

[Nikhil catches the ball.]

Nikhil: "Yes, all right."

[Nikhil kicks the football hard.]

Nikhil (happily): "And then?"

[Nikhil plays cricket in the park.]

Sonali (softly): "And then?"

[Nikhil swings on the swing.]

Nikhil (happily): "What next?"

[Nikhil goes down the slide.]

Sonali: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Nikhil plays with his dog.]

Sonali (happily): "What a day to remember!"
